financial_years.quote: impugned order in GSTIN 33ABBFM9113G1ZK/ 2019-20 dated 31.08.2024 passed by the 2nd respondent

date.quote: the notice in Form GST DRC-01 was issued by the respondents on 24.05.2024

events.quote: the notice in Form GST DRC-01 was issued by the respondents on 24.05.2024
the reply, along with all the relevant documents, were filed by the petitioner on 12.06.2024.
This writ petition has been filed challenging the impugned assessment order dated 31.08.2024.

document_contents.quote: However, the impugned order was passed by the respondent as if no documents were furnished.

defects_argued.quote: In this case, it is clear that the reply was filed by the petitioner, along with all the relevant documents, however, the said reply was not considered by the Assessing Officer while passing the impugned assessment order, which is a clear violation of principles of natural justice and hence, the said assessment order is liable to be set aside.

outcome.quote: With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
